question.text: What finalized effect estimates and intervals were supplied for six prespecified analysis populations?
question.population_or_system: six prespecified analysis populations represented in demo.csv
question.comparison_or_exposure: treatment versus reference within each analysis population
question.outcome: the declared continuous response at week 8

estimands.population_or_system: each of the six prespecified analysis populations represented in demo.csv
estimands.contrast_or_exposure: treatment minus reference within each declared analysis population
estimands.summary_measure: analysis-population-specific adjusted mean difference with supplied 95% confidence interval
estimands.effect_scale: difference in original response units; zero is the null and positive favors treatment under the declared direction
estimands.adjustment_or_aggregation: use the finalized row-specific adjusted estimates as supplied; do not pool subgroups or refit a model
estimands.missing_data_policy: inherit the finalized source analyses; the presentation input contains six complete estimate rows

claims.statement: The forest panel reproduces the six finalized adjusted mean differences and their supplied 95% confidence intervals.
claims.scope: the six precomputed rows and the source analyses they represent
claims.not_claimed: Subgroups differ from one another, treatment effects are causal, or a pooled effect was estimated.

primary: six finalized point estimates with lower and upper confidence limits
diagnostics: finite-value, bound-order, null-value, and row-order checks
context: effect direction and null value supplied by the finalized analysis record

panels.question: Where do the six finalized estimates and intervals lie relative to the declared null?
panels.replicate_unit: precomputed result; raw replication is not represented
panels.quantity_and_units: adjusted mean difference and 95% confidence limits in original response units

encoding.geometry: point estimate with horizontal confidence interval and null reference line
encoding.position: estimate and interval on x, declared analysis-population row on y
encoding.color: one neutral interval color with accessible emphasis for point estimates
encoding.scale_and_limits: linear effect scale containing all supplied interval bounds and zero

statistics.test_or_model: not-applicable: the presentation renderer does not refit or test a model
statistics.multiplicity: not evaluated by the renderer; retain the source analysis interpretation
statistics.n_definition: one finalized model contrast per displayed analysis-population row

panels.unique_contribution: presents magnitude, direction, precision, and the declared null without recomputing inference
known_risks: reversing the effect direction would invert interpretation
intervals should not be treated as between-population comparison tests

data_integrity.missingness: all six source rows contain a label, estimate, lower bound, and upper bound
data_integrity.aggregation: none; each finalized analysis-population result remains a separate row

limitations: the renderer verifies and presents supplied results but does not validate the upstream model or multiplicity strategy

visual_system.reading_order: top-to-bottom source row order, then left-to-right estimate scale
visual_system.emphasis: point estimates and intervals relative to the null
shared_scales: one linear effect scale across all six rows

color_semantics.accent: point-estimate emphasis only; color does not encode significance

review_risks.risk: viewers may infer between-population differences from overlap or non-overlap of intervals
review_risks.mitigation: state that no between-population comparison test or pooled estimate is added and avoid significance color encoding

acceptance: all six source rows retain their exact labels, order, estimates, and interval bounds
the null line is at zero and the declared effect direction is stated
no pooled estimate, p-value, significance symbol, or between-population comparison claim is introduced
SVG, PDF, and PNG match the declared physical size and PNG DPI
the final SVG has editable text and no clipping
